messages:
Maria - People Ops: Heads up team — Liam (new SWE) starts Mon 4/22. Items to finalize: I-9 (in-person vs remote), background check status, laptop courier window, temporary parking pass, and Day 1 schedule (orientation + Sam 1:1).

Jeff - IT: I can do laptop provisioning and ship. Need confirmed shipping address and permission to use standard image (docker dev tools + corp cert).

Liam - New Hire: Hi all, address is 123 Market St, Apt 4C, SF 94103. Happy with standard image. Ill bring my passport for I-9.

Anna - People Ops: BG check shows in progress with no alerts yet (TA emailed yesterday). For I-9: we have in-person slots 9:30 & 11:00 at HQ. Remote option needs secure ID upload link + timed video call. Which do you prefer, @Liam?

Liam - New Hire: 9:30 in-person works best.

Sam - Eng Manager: Ill reserve 2:00pm PT for a 30m 1:1. Maria — can you add me to the orientation agenda so I cover team norms + codebase pointers?

Security Bot: Parking pass template: provide "License plate", "Start date", and "Employee name" at https://redwood.internal/parking-request. Pass auto-activates on start date. :lock:

CourierBot: Available courier window Mon 4/22 08:00-10:00. Current hold shpt_24680. Reply with `confirm` to keep slot.

Maria - People Ops: @Jeff please confirm provisioning and keep the courier hold if @Liam confirms. Ill submit the parking request and book 9:30 I-9.

Jeff - IT: Provisioning started. Courier hold confirmed (shpt_24680) for 4/22 08:00-10:00. Temporary Slack account + VPN invite will be emailed to Liam.

Maria - People Ops: Calendar invites sent: 9:30 I-9 (HQ - I-9 Room 2, Zoom backup), 10:30-11:15 Orientation (benefits + docs + tools), 14:00 Sam 1:1. Note in I-9 invite: bring passport OR 2 acceptable IDs. If remote, use secure upload link provided by HR.

Liam - New Hire: Confirmed. License plate CA-7ABC123. Please submit parking for start date 2025-04-22. Thanks everyone!

Maria - People Ops: Done — parking request submitted. Closing loop here. If anything changes DM me or reply in thread. :wave:
